title: Interview results
description: Each real interview round: booked slot, progress, AI report, video and transcript.

states.overdue: Past the slot — no session yet

videoDeleted: Video deleted after the retention period
evaluatingHint: The report will appear here once the AI finishes scoring — usually within minutes.
abortedHint: This interview has no report. You can reschedule the candidate.
recentDescription: Real interviews that ended in the last 24 hours — open the AI report to confirm the result.
recentEmpty: No interview ended in the last 24 hours.
needsRubricHint: This round has no interview scoring criteria, so the AI could not score it. The job's primary Hiring Manager sets the criteria on the job page — the report is generated right after.
failedHint: The AI could not score this interview after several attempts{{reason}}. Click "Retry scoring" to try again.
retryQueued: Queued for scoring — the report appears automatically when done.
retryError: Could not retry scoring. Please try again.
